adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered prose-supported cytotoxicity rows, reconciled DBAASP-linked rows, exhausted the transparency-only supplement package, and accepts the paper with cautions but no open rework target.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Fig. 3-5 contain plotted bars and SDs, but XML/PDF text does not provide every bar height or exact SD; final rows retain prose-supported exact values and matched DBAASP rows only.
The only OA supplementary archive, mmc1.zip, lists COI/transparency PDFs and no assay spreadsheet/table.
DBAASP-linked sequence rows are absent from the packet; peptide identity is source-verified from primary Fig. 1 chemical structures/nomenclature.
Cytotoxicity and phospholipid-bubble interaction support phenotype/model-membrane context but do not establish a direct intact-cell molecular target.
The source itself cautions that high/frequent dose would be needed for oral administration and that topical/derivative development is the more plausible direction.

supplementary_assets.note: Associated supplementary archive is a transparency/COI zip, not assay data; no source-supported activity values remain hidden in local supplements.

per_layer_decision_rationale.final_decision: Previous rework codes full_source_review_not_completed, database_conflicts_require_adjudication, and no_supported_activity_rows_extracted are resolved; no blocking material gap remains locally.
